Class AssignmentsController

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.controllers.ApiController
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.controllers.AssignmentsController
@RequestMapping("/api/assignments") @RestController public class AssignmentsController extends ApiController
Assignments of a course, and the jobs that create their repositories. Creating or editing an assignment saves it and starts the job that creates its individual or team repositories.

    • postAssignment

      @PreAuthorize("@CourseSecurity.hasManagePermissions(#root, #courseId)") @PostMapping("/post") public AssignmentWithJob postAssignment(@RequestParam Long courseId, @RequestParam String repoPrefix, @RequestParam AssignmentType asnType, @RequestParam Visibility visibility, @RequestParam Permission permission, @RequestParam(required=false) RepositoryCreationOption createReposFor, @RequestParam(required=false) String teamRegex) throws EntityNotFoundException
      Creates an assignment and starts the job that creates its repositories.

      For an INDIVIDUAL assignment, createReposFor says whom repositories are created for (default STUDENTS_ONLY) and teamRegex must not be given. For a TEAM assignment, teamRegex is the regular expression that team names must match (default ".*", every team) and createReposFor must not be given.

      Parameters:
      courseId - the ID of the course the assignment is for
      repoPrefix - each repository created begins with this prefix
      asnType - the assignment type (individual vs team)
      visibility - the visibility of the repositories (public vs private)
      permission - the permission that students, or teams, have on the repositories
      createReposFor - INDIVIDUAL only: whom to create repositories for
      teamRegex - TEAM only: only teams whose names match get a repository
      Returns:
      the created assignment and the job started to create the repositories
      Throws:
      EntityNotFoundException

    • updateAssignment

      @PreAuthorize("@CourseSecurity.hasManagePermissions(#root, #courseId)") @PutMapping("/put") public AssignmentWithJob updateAssignment(@RequestParam Long courseId, @RequestParam Long assignmentId, @RequestParam String repoPrefix, @RequestParam Visibility visibility, @RequestParam Permission permission, @RequestParam(required=false) RepositoryCreationOption createReposFor, @RequestParam(required=false) String teamRegex) throws EntityNotFoundException
      Updates an assignment and starts the job that creates its repositories. The assignment type cannot be changed: to change an individual assignment to a team one, or the other way round, delete the assignment and create a new one. The same rules as for creating apply to createReposFor and teamRegex, according to the assignment's type.
      Parameters:
      courseId - the ID of the course the assignment belongs to
      assignmentId - the ID of the assignment
      repoPrefix - each repository created begins with this prefix
      visibility - the visibility of the repositories (public vs private)
      permission - the permission that students, or teams, have on the repositories
      createReposFor - INDIVIDUAL only: whom to create repositories for
      teamRegex - TEAM only: only teams whose names match get a repository
      Returns:
      the updated assignment and the job started to create the repositories
      Throws:
      EntityNotFoundException
